paragraphs: TLDR (human) ---> 8ball is a web-enabled online Jev proxy. It uses Claude to turn human input into a proper prompt with context for Jev and then displays the result with some (in my opinion, pretty neat) graphics. It also gives Claude the option to request web search through Hack Club's Exa API and conduct up to 2 rounds of research. If you'd like to see the full prompts/responses, check the console. I did NOT code this, I used replit agent to make it in a few hours. There is a strict lifetime usage limit of 3 responses because the responses are coming from Hack Club AI's API.
8Ball An independent Jev online playground with a black-and-white, pixel-art interface. Ask a question, let Claude prepare the context, and see Jev's answer inside an interactive eight ball.
8Ball is not an official Jev site. It is not made, operated, or endorsed by, or officially affiliated with, Hack Club.
